description: Discover Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (GDEX has no Polymarket/Kalshi). Returns normalised markets: outcomeId, title, sides[] (label, coin "#<assetId>", balanceCoin "+<assetId>", price = current mid), quoteToken (collateral, held in the HL spot balance), state (active | pre_launch | expired | settled), rules (price 0.00001-0.99999 tick 0.00001, whole-contract size, min order notional 11 quote), settlement (no claim via GDEX). withVolume=true adds volume24h {volume, asOf, source, coverage} with a bounded wait. raw=true returns the backend payload unchanged.

detail.description: Full market records (rules, params, settlement). Default: compact rows

excludeFallback.description: Hide "none of the listed outcomes" legs

query.description: Case-insensitive text match on title / side labels / params, or an exact outcomeId

raw.description: Return the raw backend payload instead

sortBy.description: volume: highest 24h volume first (implies withVolume); expiry: soonest first

name: hl_outcomes
